title: Data of thousands of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customers leaked after cyberattack on third-party providers
content_md:
Data of thousands of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customers leaked after a cyberattack on third-party providers. The companies clarify what information was affected.

via Mastodon https://elfolio.es/filtracion-de-datos-de-visa-mastercard-y-jpmorgan/
